Okay, awesome. Good evening again, trustees, for the 3rd time tonight.
Thank you so much. All right, and that wraps our public comments.
All right, we're having a little bit of fun with the wireless mics, right?
And I think that takes us to the end of 15.1. Yeah. Approval to move forward.
Can we approve the formation of iTelc? For the approval of formation of the iTelc.
